# BrightRoom Proposal

Hi, and thank you for your enquiry.

**Your request:** 13 people, 4 hours, coffee, budget €400.

Your group doesn't fit within the €400 budget as asked. Here is why, and two ways forward.

## Option A: Fits all 13 people (recommended if headcount is fixed)

| Item | Calculation | Price |
|---|---|---|
| Loft (4 hours, up to 24 people, wheelchair accessible, Wi-Fi included) | | €420 |
| Coffee break | 13 × €8 | €104 |
| **Total** | | **€524** |

The Studio holds a maximum of 12 people, so for 13 the Loft is the only venue that works. The Loft alone (€420) is already above your budget. This option is **€124 over budget**.

## Option B: Within budget, if you can reduce to 12 people

| Item | Calculation | Price |
|---|---|---|
| Studio (4 hours, max 12 people, Wi-Fi included) | | €240 |
| Coffee break | 12 × €8 | €96 |
| **Total** | | **€336** |

This leaves €64 of your budget free. Note that the Studio is reached by stairs only and is **not wheelchair accessible**. If you wanted to, you could add a projector (€35) for a total of €371, still within budget.

## Good to know
- All prices are final totals in euros, with no taxes or fees.
- We only offer 4-hour bookings, and we can't offer discounts.
- The coffee break must cover every attendee.
- **Your date still needs an availability check.** Please tell us your preferred date(s) and we'll confirm.

Let us know which option suits you and we'll check availability.

Best regards,
BrightRoom
